snippet.title: Tales of Berseria Remastered – Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
In a world consumed by a malevolence-fueled curse, she rises with a single purpose... vengeance.
 
Tales of Berseria Remastered releases 27th February on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, Steam, and Nintendo Switch. 

Pre-order now: https://bnent.eu/Preorder-TOBR
